## CLOSED — mcp delta gate now ORs SECRETS_PATHS (fix merged)

**Root cause.** `autodeploy.sh`'s mcp change-detection gate consulted only `MCP_PATHS`; a
commit touching only `SECRETS_PATHS` (`fetch-secrets.sh` / `ssm.tf`) refreshed the shared on-disk
`.env` but never built a NEW `rebar-mcp` container, so the running server kept a stale
environment. mcp reads `.env`/`mcp-static-tokens.json` once at container init, so on-disk refresh
without a new container is a no-op for the live process.

**Precedent / standing intent.** The review-bot gate has ORed `SECRETS_PATHS` since **f600 /
incident-2731** (`autodeploy.sh:853-854`) — that is why `SECRETS_PATHS` exists as a distinct
variable. The mcp block was never given the same treatment. The fix mirrors the bot gate exactly.

**Fix.** Added `mcp_delta()` beside `changed()`, ORing `MCP_PATHS || SECRETS_PATHS` over
`$mcp_deployed..$TARGET`; both mcp gate arms (backoff-active + backoff-clear) now call it, with a
comment naming mcp as the other fetch-secrets consumer.

**RED evidence (held-out TDD).** `test_secrets_only_change_redeploys_mcp` (parametrized over
`fetch-secrets.sh` and `ssm.tf`, on the real-bash `_real_git_box` harness; `ssm.tf` added to the
repo baseline) asserts a secrets-only change emits BOTH `compose-build-mcp` AND
`run --name rebar-mcp` — RED-first (bot redeployed, mcp did not), then GREEN. Teeth confirmed by a
defect-seeded mutation (re-omit SECRETS_PATHS → RED). A second test,
`test_secrets_only_delta_is_pending_during_mcp_backoff`, covers the backoff-active arm.

**Landed via Gerrit.** Change **2428** — `LLM-Review +1` AND `Verified +1` on the final patchset,
Submitted, **MERGED as `b14d05dfc0b0`**. `make lint` + `make typecheck` + full mcp module (45
tests) clean locally.

**Attribution.** `caused_by` → `6964-40bb-46c9-48a7` (added the mcp delta gate without teaching it
about the already-existing `SECRETS_PATHS` consumer). Class **plan_defect** (missed-consumer
update).

**AC4 (live on-box validation) — DEFERRED TO DEPLOY WINDOW.** It inherently cannot be proven from
a code snapshot and was out of reach under the read-only-box constraint. Split out and tracked to
completion in follow-up **`edgy-wholesome-cuckoo` (`1d88-7113-4f8e-4e73`)**, linked
`discovered_from` this ticket: an operator must, at the next secrets-only deploy, confirm a new
`rebar-mcp` container starts with the refreshed environment and record the journal lines +
container identity + timestamp there.
